title: She and the Meeting
prompt: What had she finished before the meeting started?
hint: Refer to the 'Past Perfect Tense Usage' sentence; it says what she completed.
sample: She had finished her work before the meeting.

ja.prompt: 彼女は会議が始まる前に何を終えていましたか？
ja.hint: 『Past Perfect Tense Usage』の文を見てください。彼女が終えたものが書かれています。
ja.sample: She had finished her work before the meeting.
